text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: The Game Boy was released in 1989 as Nintendo's first major handheld console and established a new standard for portable gaming. It combined simple hardware with efficient design, long battery life, and a large cartridge-based library. The system became known for games such as Tetris, Super Mario Land, The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening, Pokémon Red and Blue, and Metroid II: Return of Samus. Despite having a monochrome display, the Game Boy became one of the best-selling video game systems and remained supported for more than a decade.
